text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Jalan Persekutuan

(Lebuh Raya Lembah Klang Selatan) 2013.

 (2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 Oktober 2013.

Perisytiharan jalan sebagai jalan Persekutuan

2. (1) Bahagian jalan yang dikenali sebagai Lebuh Raya Lembah Klang Selatan

yang bermula dari kilometer 0.00 Lebuh Raya Lembah Klang Selatan

(di koordinat U 329697.90, T 414938.35, Grid Rectified Skew Orthomorphic (RSO))

dan berakhir di kilometer 52.98 (di koordinat U 322990.08, T 370915.42 Grid Rectified

Skew Orthomorphic (RSO)) (kedua-dua jarak diukur dari Persimpangan Bertingkat

UNITEN), termasuklah Persimpangan Bertingkat Putra, Persimpangan Bertingkat

Wetland, Persimpangan Bertingkat SKVE, Plaza Tol Masuk/Keluar Ayer Hitam,

Persimpangan Bertingkat SKVE Saujana Putra, Plaza Tol Masuk/Keluar SKVE Saujana

Putra, Persimpangan Bertingkat Teluk Panglima Garang, Plaza Tol Masuk/Keluar Teluk

Panglima Garang, Plaza Tol Masuk/Keluar Pulau Indah dan Persimpangan Bertingkat

Pulau Indah iaitu suatu jarak sepanjang 52.98 kilometer diisytiharkan sebagai jalan

Persekutuan.

 (2) Jalan yang diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan di bawah

subperenggan (1) ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual.

Pembatalan

3. Perintah Jalan Persekutuan (Lebuh Raya Lembah Klang Selatan) 2012

[P.U. (A) 148/2012] dibatalkan.

FEDERAL ROADS ACT 1959

FEDERAL ROADS (SOUTH KLANG VALLEY EXPRESSWAY) ORDER 2013

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 3 of the Federal Roads Act 1959

[Act 376], the Minister, after consultation with the State Government of Selangor, makes

the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (South Klang Valley

Expressway) Order 2013.

 (2) This Order comes into operation on 1 October 2013.

Declaration as a Federal road

2. (1) The part of the road known as the South Klang Valley Expressway

commences from kilometre 0.00 South Klang Valley Expressway

(at coordinates N 329697.90, E 414938.35 of the Rectified Skew Orthormorphic Grid

(RSO)) and ending at kilometre 52.98 (at coordinates N 322990.08, E 370915.42 of the

Rectified Skew Orthormorphic Grid (RSO)) (both the distances measured from UNITEN

Interchange), including Putra Interchange, Wetland Interchange, SKVE Interchange,

Ayer Hitam Entry/Exit Toll Plaza, SKVE Saujana Putra Interchange, SKVE Saujana Putra

Entry/Exit Toll Plaza, Teluk Panglima Garang Interchange, Teluk Panglima Garang

Entry/Exit Toll Plaza, Pulau Indah Entry/Exit Toll Plaza and Pulau Indah Interchange,

being a distance of 52.98 kilometre is declared to be a Federal road.

 (2) The road declared as a Federal road under subparagraph (1) is shown on

the map in the Schedule.

Revocation

3. The Federal Roads (South Klang Valley Expressway) Order 2012

[P.U. (A) 148/2012] is revoked.
